description.value: The sxʷeŋxʷəŋ təŋəxʷ James Bay Branch is a neighbourhood branch of the Greater Victoria Public Library, opened in April 2018 and named with a Lekwungen place name honouring the traditional territory on which it sits. It sits in the heart of James Bay, one of Victoria's most cycle-friendly and historically rich neighbourhoods, just a short ride from the Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park. As a public library branch, it offers public computers, a broad physical and digital collection, and a welcoming indoor space for anyone passing through the area.
